# hpe_morpheus_cluster (Data Source)



`hpe_morpheus_cluster` data source provides details about an existing Morpheus cluster by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_cluster" "example" {
  name = "Example name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the cluster
- `name` (String) The name of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_id` (Number) The Cloud ID of the cluster.
- `description` (String)
- `group_id` (Number) The Group ID of the cluster.
- `labels` (Set of String)
- `layout_id` (Number) The Layout ID of the cluster.
- `service_url` (String)
- `uuid` (String)
